Historical OpenPowerlifting competition performances

Source: R/data.R
powerlifting.Rd

A prepared extract of complete three-lift competition performances from the OpenPowerlifting database. Records missing a positive squat, bench press, deadlift, total, or bodyweight were removed. The data are an historical snapshot and a person can occur more than once across competitions.

Usage

data(powerlifting)

Format

A data frame with one row per competition performance and 11 fields:

sex

Competition sex category: F or M.

equipment

Equipment category.

age

Age in years; may be missing.

bodyweight_kg

Recorded bodyweight in kilograms.

weight_class_kg

Meet-reported weight class.

squat_kg

Best successful squat in kilograms.

bench_kg

Best successful bench press in kilograms.

deadlift_kg

Best successful deadlift in kilograms.

total_kg

Official three-lift total in kilograms.

place

Meet-reported placing, including non-numeric statuses.

wilks

Meet-reported Wilks score; may be missing.

Source

OpenPowerlifting, historical database extract distributed through https://www.kaggle.com/open-powerlifting/powerlifting-database. Current project documentation is at https://openpowerlifting.gitlab.io/opl-csv/bulk-csv-docs.html.
